title: L0177
description: Output of an L0177 program — the normalized Author API integration design plus steering warnings. This is NOT the deliverable; the developer-facing recipe is produced by get_spec. Atomic dialect (not a composition upstream).

mode.description: The Author API view the design targets (selected by the view function).

domain.description: The serving domain the signature binds to.

user.description: The author identity (only id is required).

organisation_id.description: Which item bank to load from.

allow_widgets.description: Question types the design intends (mapped from UPPERCASE tags). Design INTENT only — no confirmed config key restricts at question-type granularity; question_type_groups is what the API enforces.

config.description: The view's members, folded by kind (e.g. { item, widget, settings }), plus any view-level scalars. A member's legal fields depend on the view: config.item_edit.item and config.item_list.item are different Learnosity nodes. Fields that don't belong are dropped, not passed through.

paths.description: Every config key this design set, mapped to its exact Learnosity path (e.g. "config.item.reference-prefix" -> "config.item_edit.item.reference.prefix"). The recipe must read paths from here rather than deriving them from kebab key names, which are ambiguous about nesting. A key absent here was dropped and must not appear in the recipe.

complete.description: True when the design has no unfilled required properties (holes).

warnings.description: Steering hints: design holes first (missing required properties), then specificity advisories. The client refines the design until these clear.

question_type_groups.description: The verified picker restriction: all ten default question-type groups, with template_references omitted on those kept and [] on those removed. Emit at config.dependencies.question_editor_api.init_options.question_type_groups (see paths). Naming only the wanted groups would restrict nothing — an unrecognised group reference is additive.
